role: Independent public-surface reviewer of the EFC corpus.
independence_caveat: Same model family as the other five reviewers; agreement is reading consistency, not independent validation.

findings.excerpt: The density-of-states derivation (31942800) completes the Gamma(rho) bridge: Deff ~ sqrt(rho/rho_crit), yielding Gamma = Gamma0*sqrt(rho/rho_crit)/(1+sqrt(rho/rho_crit)) with rho_crit = a0/(GN*lg). Scenario B+, '~20% agreement with phenomenological ansatz'.
findings.falsified_by: A verified Ledger version lacking this equation, or the 31942800 package no longer stating the square-root bridge and Scenario B+.

findings.excerpt: The companion derivation (31942821) provides the first explicit derivation of Gamma from BE occupation + von Neumann entropy, yielding Gamma ~ rho^(3/2)/(rho+rho_crit) (Scenario B).
findings.falsified_by: A verified Ledger revision removing the rho^(3/2) statement, or 31942821 source no longer specifying the 3/2 form.

findings.excerpt: Changelog publishes the B+ square-root form and the BE-derivation rho/(rho+rho_crit) form as separate entries on the same date; does not select one canonical form.
findings.falsified_by: A public page presenting one designated canonical Gamma form and removing or formally versioning the other.

findings.excerpt: index description says 'yields a saturating form Gamma = Gamma0*rho/(rho+rho_crit)'; key_result says 'Gamma ~ rho^(3/2)/(rho+rho_crit) from BE+vN entropy - Scenario B'.
findings.falsified_by: A synchronized DOI package where description, key_result, equations and source code state the same exponent.

findings.excerpt: Result: Gamma ~ rho^(3/2)/(rho+rho_crit) as derived total; rho/(rho+rho_crit) retained only as a separately named phenomenological ansatz.
findings.falsified_by: The package source after a verified revision no longer implementing rho_ratio**1.5/(1+rho_ratio), or the phenomenological function no longer separate.

findings.excerpt: Bosonic statistics, gradient-coupled excitation energy E ~ sqrt(g), and a single scale a0 reproduce the BE RAR mu(g)=1/(exp(sqrt(g/a0))-1) with no free parameters.
findings.falsified_by: A verified public revision replacing sqrt(g/a0) with g/a0, or the BE/RAR package no longer supporting the square-root exponent.

findings.excerpt: core_equations.be_occupation: n(g)=1/(exp(g/a0)-1); the same index states x(rho) = g/a0 = sqrt(beta*rho/a0); source code documents n(g)=1/(exp(sqrt(g/a0))-1).
findings.falsified_by: A corrected package metadata record consistently specifying either the linear-g or sqrt-g exponent across be_occupation, x_of_rho and source code.

findings.excerpt: Ledger publishes B and B+ simultaneously; Changelog publishes rho/(rho+rho_crit) and sqrt(rho/rho_crit) forms. No single final Gamma form selected.
findings.falsified_by: A versioned public narrative saying Scenario B is superseded by Scenario B+ and identifying rho/(rho+rho_crit) as phenomenological rather than derived.

verdict: The public surface is not a single-form, single-version representation. It simultaneously publishes Gamma forms for Scenario B (rho^(3/2)), Scenario B+ (sqrt(rho) saturation), and, in the Changelog's 31942821 entry, the phenomenological rho/(rho+rho_crit) form. The public BE exponent is sqrt(g/a0), agreeing with the source code's sqrt convention but conflicting with the linear-g expression in 31942821 metadata. The primary issue is public-surface and metadata/terminology consistency, not an established physical contradiction.
falsification: This review would be falsified by a synchronized, versioned source set showing the public pages contain only the final canonical Gamma form, that 31942821 metadata, key_result, equations and code all agree on one exponent, and that the BE exponent is identical across public HTML, index.json and source code.
